annotations.title: Cross-border salary: moving to the Netherlands, or commuting with Germany, Belgium and others

description: Salary between the Netherlands and Germany, Belgium, the United Kingdom, India, Poland or Romania under the tax treaty and EU social security rules. mode "move": the year someone moves to the Netherlands (2026): Dutch tax on the resident part, the home country's tax on the salary before the move (Germany with progression; India's 182-day test for its April-March year), whether the home country also taxes the Dutch salary, and social security when posted. mode "commute": someone living in one country and working for an employer in the other: the salary split by working days (Germany: up to 34 home-working days from 2026 do not shift the taxing right), which country relieves double tax and how, and which country's social security applies (25% rule, telework framework agreement). Each answer cites the treaty articles. Salary only; Belgian and Polish tax amounts are not calculated yet.

country.description: The other country: DE, BE, GB, IN, PL or RO

days_in_residence.description: commute: working days worked in the country of residence, home working included. Default 0.

fx_per_eur.description: move: 1 euro = this many units of the home currency (optional; ignored for euro countries)

gross_annual.description: commute: gross yearly salary in euros

holiday_allowance.description: move: 8% holiday allowance on the Dutch salary. Default true.

home_salary_before_move.description: move: salary earned in the home country in 2026 before the move, in its currency. Default 0.

lives_in.description: commute: where the person lives; the employer is in the other country. Default other (lives abroad, works for a Dutch employer).

mode.description: move = the year of moving to the Netherlands; commute = living in one country, working in the other

move_date.description: move: first day living in the Netherlands, YYYY-MM-DD in 2026

nl_gross_annual.description: move: Dutch gross salary for a full year, euros, without holiday allowance

posted.description: move: still employed and posted by the home employer. Default false.

telework_request.description: commute: employer and employee jointly asked to apply the EU telework framework agreement. Default false.

thirty_percent_ruling.description: move: 30% ruling on the Dutch salary. Default false.

working_days.description: commute: total working days in the year. Default 220.

name: cross_border_salary_netherlands
title: Cross-border salary: moving to the Netherlands, or commuting with Germany, Belgium and others
